Analysis.object: We found correlations between self-oriented perfectionism and body image idealisation en fitness athletes, but not in Females references. This finding may be a potential moderator of how drive for leanness differentially correlates to ED, with more cognitive and eating restictions in fitness athletes and more uncontrolled and emotional eating in Females references.

Use of questionnaires developed and primarily validated for others populations samples (i.e., BES and TFE-Q for obese persons; CAPS for adolescents; DFL and DM for males), no clinical interviews and a short follow-up period.

Population.object: Participants fitness and body building athletes ; all responding Female fitness athletes planning to participate in the upcoming Norwegian competition period and initiating an energy restricted diet for such attendance, aged 18-40 years were included. Recreationally active Female at comparable age, with a body mass index of 18.5-35, and with no former of planned future experience with fitness or bodybuilding sports, or current profession as a personal trainer were included. For references athletes additional criterion was being recreationally physically active within any kind of sport/activity at least two times per week during the current year.
